items.q: The first caliph of Islam.
The second caliph, called al-Faruq.
The third caliph, called Dhul-Nurayn.
The fourth caliph, cousin and son-in-law of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
The four caliphs together are called this.
The ten Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩ given glad tidings of Paradise by name.
The Companion who gave the first call to prayer.
The daughter of our Beloved Master ﷺ, wife of our master 'Ali ﵁.
The two grandsons of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
items.a: Our masters al-Hasan and al-Husayn ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩

items.q: Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ called them "the leaders of the youth of Paradise" (paraphrased).
items.a: Our masters al-Hasan and al-Husayn ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩

items.q: The Companion called "Sayf Allah" (Sword of Allah).
The Persian Companion who searched for the truth across lands.
The Companion called "Amin hadhihi al-Ummah" (trustee of this Ummah).
The wives of our Beloved Master ﷺ are called this.
items.a: Ummahat al-Mu'minin (Mothers of the Believers ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِنَّ)⁩)

items.q: The young Companion who became a great scholar of tafsir.
Our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ servant for about ten years.
The Companion our Beloved Prophet ﷺ called "the most knowledgeable of halal and haram" (paraphrased).
The uncle of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ called "Asad Allah" (Lion of Allah).
The Companion who was the first ambassador of Islam, sent to teach Yathrib.
The caliph who had the Qur'an copied into one standard Mushaf and sent copies to the great cities.
The son of our master 'Umar ﵁, famed for following the Sunnah closely.
The Companion whose footsteps our Beloved Prophet ﷺ heard ahead of Him ﷺ in Paradise (meaning).
The first free adult man to accept Islam, by the common view.
The first boy to accept Islam.
The first freed slave to accept Islam.
The Companion who was with our Beloved Prophet ﷺ in the cave of Thawr during the Hijrah.
The first martyr of Islam, a woman of Makkah who would not give up her faith.
The son of Sumayyah ﵂, who was tortured with his parents in Makkah.
The Companion who was laid on burning sand in Makkah and kept saying "Ahad, Ahad".
The Companion who bought Bilal ﵁ and set him free.
The cousin of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ who spoke for the Muslims before the Negus of Abyssinia.
items.a: Our master Ja'far ibn Abi Talib ﵁

items.q: The Companion who slept in our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ bed on the night of the Hijrah.
The daughter of our master Abu Bakr ﵁ called "Dhat al-Nitaqayn", she of the two waist-bands.
The Companion who suggested digging a trench around Madinah.
The Companion whose house near al-Safa was the early meeting place of the Muslims in Makkah.
The Companion who narrated more hadith than any other.
The blind Companion who gave the adhan in Madinah alongside Bilal ﵁.
Our master Abu Bakr ﵁ was called "al-Siddiq" because he did this at once when told of the Night Journey.
Our master 'Uthman ﵁ is called Dhul-Nurayn because he married these two daughters of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ, one after the other.
items.a: Our ladies Ruqayyah and Umm Kulthum ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩

items.q: The Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩ who left Makkah for Madinah are known by this name.
The Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩ of Madinah who welcomed and helped the emigrants are known by this name.
The pairing of each Muhajir with an Ansari as brothers after the Hijrah.
The Arabic word for one Companion of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
The poor Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩ who lived in a shaded part of the Mosque of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ are known by this name.
The Companion who faced and overcame the champion 'Amr ibn 'Abd Wudd at the Battle of the Trench.
At Khaybar, our Beloved Prophet ﷺ gave the banner to the man "whom Allah and His Messenger love" (meaning). Who was he?
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said that through this grandson Allah would make peace between two great groups of Muslims (meaning).
The second woman our Beloved Prophet ﷺ married, after our lady Khadijah ﵂.
The first wife of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ, who supported Him ﷺ with her wealth.
The Mother of the Believers who was a great scholar and narrator.
Asked what he had left for his family after giving all his wealth, this Companion said he had left them Allah and His Messenger ﷺ (meaning).
The cemetery of Madinah al-Munawwarah where many Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩ rest.
The ten promised Paradise include the four caliphs, Talhah, al-Zubayr, 'Abd al-Rahman ibn 'Awf, Sa'd, Sa'id and this one ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩.
The Companion who was the first to shoot an arrow in the way of Allah.
The commander of the Muslims at al-Qadisiyyah.
The Companion called the "disciple" (hawari) of our Beloved Master ﷺ.
The wealthy Companion who began life in Madinah asking to be shown the market.
The Companion who shielded our Beloved Prophet ﷺ with his hand at Uhud, which was left paralysed.
The Companion who was the scribe of revelation and collected the Qur'an.
The Companion whose recitation our Beloved Prophet ﷺ loved and asked to hear.
The Companion whose voice was compared to the flutes of the family of our master Dawud ﵇.
The poet of our Beloved Master ﷺ who answered the poets of Quraysh.
The Companion who conquered Egypt.
The young Companion appointed by our Beloved Prophet ﷺ to lead an army including senior Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩.
The Mother of the Believers whose wise advice at al-Hudaybiyah helped the Muslims.
The Ansari leader whose passing shook the Throne.
The host of our Beloved Master ﷺ in Madinah, who passed away near Constantinople.
The first to recite the Qur'an aloud to Quraysh near the Ka'bah, according to Ibn Ishaq ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩.
The Companion of the Ghifar tribe known for zuhd, called "the most truthful in speech".
The caliph who first had the Qur'an gathered into one set of pages after the Battle of Yamamah.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ gave our master 'Ali ﵁ this nickname, finding him lying in the dust.
The Rightly Guided caliphate would last this many years, as our Beloved Prophet ﷺ foretold (meaning).
items.src: Sunan Abi Dawud; Sunan al-Tirmidhi (hadith of Safinah)

items.q: The Ansari brother of 'Abd al-Rahman ibn 'Awf ﵁ who offered him half of all he owned.
The Companion paired as brother with Salman al-Farisi ﵁, who was told "your body has a right over you".
The two young Ansari Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩ who struck down Abu Jahl at Badr.
items.a: Mu'adh ibn 'Amr ibn al-Jamuh and Mu'adh ibn 'Afra' ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩

items.q: The lame Ansari Companion who insisted on going out to Uhud and was martyred there.
The pledge the Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩ gave under the tree at al-Hudaybiyah.
At Bay'at al-Ridwan, our Beloved Prophet ﷺ struck one hand on the other for this absent Companion.
The Companion who wrote out the Treaty of al-Hudaybiyah.
The son of Suhayl ibn 'Amr ﵁ who came in chains to al-Hudaybiyah and was sent back under the treaty.
The Companion who carried our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ letter to Heraclius.
The Ansari Companion who gave his beloved garden Bayruha' in charity when a verse on spending what you love came down.
On the same day, this Companion brought half of his wealth, hoping to outdo our master Abu Bakr ﵁.
The Companion who equipped much of the "Army of Hardship" for Tabuk.
The Companion called "the beloved of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ" (hibb), son of Zayd ibn Harithah ﵁.
The woman who cared for our Beloved Prophet ﷺ as a child and was mother of Usamah ﵁.
The chief of Yamamah who was tied to a pillar of the mosque in Madinah, then set free and accepted Islam.
The Companion who saw the words of the adhan in a dream.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ took this Companion's hand, said "I love you", and taught him a supplication to say after every prayer (meaning).
The Companion who spread his cloak before our Beloved Prophet ﷺ and after that forgot nothing he heard.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ prayed that Allah would teach this young cousin the understanding of the religion.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ prayed that Allah increase this servant's wealth and children and bless him in them.
The uncle of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ who gave water to the pilgrims (al-siqayah).
On the day Makkah was opened, whoever entered this Companion's house was declared safe.
The given name of our master Abu Bakr al-Siddiq ﵁.
The Companion from Yemen whose descendant, Imam Abu al-Hasan al-Ash'ari ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩, gave his name to a school of creed.
Our master Abu Bakr ﵁ fought the wars against those who refused zakat and false prophets, called this.
The false prophet killed at the Battle of Yamamah.
The city our master 'Umar ﵁ entered peacefully and gave a covenant to its people.
The Companion who led the prayer in our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ place during His ﷺ last illness.
The caliph who began counting the years of the Islamic calendar from the Hijrah.
The Companion who was the first in Islam to be called "Amir al-Mu'minin".
The Companion governor of al-Sham under our masters 'Umar and 'Uthman ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩, later caliph.
items.a: Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩

items.q: The kunyah of our master 'Ali ibn Abi Talib ﵁, besides Abu Turab.
Our lady Khadijah ﵂ passed away in this year, which also took Abu Talib.
The Companion who was given the title "Sayyid al-Shuhada'" as the master of martyrs.
The Companion our master 'Umar ﵁ sent to Kufah as teacher and treasurer, who founded its scholarship.
The Companion sent by our Beloved Prophet ﷺ as judge and teacher to Yemen.
The Companion who was the first to be born to the Muhajirun in Madinah.
The mother of 'Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr ﵁.
The Companion who was our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ "keeper of secrets", who knew the names of the hypocrites (meaning).
The Companion of the Ansar given the name "Dhul-Shahadatayn" (his witness counts as two).
The Companion whom the angels ﵈ washed after he fell at Uhud.
The Companion who carried the banner at Uhud until he was martyred.
The Companion, a former slave, whom our Beloved Prophet ﷺ adopted before adoption was ended.
The Mother of the Believers whose marriage was ordered in the Qur'an.
The Mother of the Believers who was the daughter of our master 'Umar ﵁.
The Mother of the Believers who gave her turn to our lady 'A'ishah ﵂.
The Mother of the Believers who was the daughter of Abu Sufyan ﵁.
The Mother of the Believers from the Jewish tribe of Banu al-Nadir.
The Mother of the Believers whose marriage freed many of her people, Banu al-Mustaliq.
The last wife our Beloved Master ﷺ married.
The son of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ who passed away as a baby in Madinah.
The mother of our master Ibrahim ﵇, son of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
The eldest daughter of our Beloved Master ﷺ.
The four daughters of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
items.a: Our ladies Zaynab, Ruqayyah, Umm Kulthum and Fatimah ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِنَّ)⁩

items.q: "Take the Qur'an from four": Ibn Mas'ud, Salim, Mu'adh and this Companion ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩ (meaning).
The mother of Anas ibn Malik ﵁, who gave her son to serve our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
The poet who came to Madinah to seek pardon and recited the ode "Banat Su'ad".
The three Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩ who stayed behind from Tabuk and whose repentance came down in the Qur'an.
items.a: Ka'b ibn Malik, Hilal ibn Umayyah and Murarah ibn al-Rabi' ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩

items.q: The father of our master Abu Bakr ﵁, who accepted Islam on the day Makkah was opened.
The poet-chief of Daws who brought his tribe to Islam, among them Abu Hurayrah ﵁.
The son of the famously generous Hatim of Tayy, who accepted Islam.
The son of Abu Jahl who accepted Islam after Makkah was opened and was martyred at Yarmuk.
Our master 'Umar ﵁ accepted Islam after hearing verses of this surah at his sister's house.
The sister of our master 'Umar ﵁, in whose house he heard the Qur'an.
The husband of Fatimah bint al-Khattab ﵂, one of the ten promised Paradise.
The given name of Abu 'Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah ﵁.
The given name of Abu Hurayrah ﵁, by the most common view.
The given name of Abu Dharr al-Ghifari ﵁.
The given name of Abu Ayyub al-Ansari ﵁.
The given name of Abu al-Darda' ﵁, by the common view.
The two great generals who came to Madinah together in 8 AH / 629 CE to accept Islam, with 'Uthman ibn Talhah ﵁.
items.a: Khalid ibn al-Walid and 'Amr ibn al-'As ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩

items.q: The Companion who left all his wealth to Quraysh to be allowed to emigrate, and was told "the trade has profited" (meaning).
The three poets of the Ansar who defended our Beloved Prophet ﷺ in verse.
items.a: Hassan ibn Thabit, Ka'b ibn Malik and 'Abdullah ibn Rawahah ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩

items.q: The rabbi of Madinah who accepted Islam soon after the Hijrah and was given glad tidings of Paradise.
The only Companion named in the Qur'an.
The Companion at Badr who threw away his dates, saying it would be too long a life to finish them, and fought until martyred.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said "Shoot, may my father and mother be your ransom" to this archer at Uhud.
The Companion whose night recitation drew something like a cloud with lamps, which our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said were angels ﵈ listening.
The woman Companion whose only mahr was Abu Talhah's ﵁ acceptance of Islam.
At his burial, this Companion's cloak was too short: covering his head left his feet bare.
The Companion known as the orator (khatib) of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ and of the Ansar.
The young Companion of Makkah whom our Beloved Prophet ﷺ taught the adhan, later the muezzin of Makkah.
Our master Ja'far ﵁ was given this title because he was given two wings in Paradise.
The Companion called "Habr al-Ummah" (the scholar of the Ummah).
The Companion who chased our Beloved Prophet ﷺ on the Hijrah, whose horse sank into the sand, and who was promised the bracelets of Chosroes.
Our master 'Umar ﵁ was martyred in this year.
Our master Abu Bakr ﵁ passed away in this year.
Our master 'Uthman ﵁ was martyred in this year.
Our master 'Ali ﵁ was martyred in this year.
The Companion who killed Musaylimah, with others.
Our master 'Umar ﵁ founded the register of stipends called this.
The great battle against the Byzantines in 15 AH / 636 CE.
The great battle against the Persians, around 15 AH / 636 CE.
The Companion who led at Yarmuk, with Khalid ﵁.
The plague in al-Sham in 18 AH / 639 CE in which Abu 'Ubaydah and Mu'adh ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩ passed away.
The six-man council that our master 'Umar ﵁ named to choose the next caliph.
The Companion who ran the council and chose our master 'Uthman ﵁.
Our master 'Uthman ﵁ bought this well and gave it to the Muslims.
Our master 'Ali ﵁ moved the capital to this city.
The last Companion to pass away, by the common view.
The last Companion to pass away in Madinah, by one view.
One of the two women who gave allegiance at the second 'Aqabah, who later fought to defend our Beloved Prophet ﷺ at Uhud.
The keeper of the Ka'bah's key, to whom our Beloved Prophet ﷺ returned it on the day Makkah was opened.
Our master 'Umar ﵁ made this Persian Companion governor of al-Mada'in, where he lived very simply.
The last of the ten promised Paradise to pass away, by the common view.
Our master 'Umar ﵁ gathered the people for Tarawih behind this one reciter.
The Companion called "Sayyid al-Qurra'", the master of the reciters.
The Companion called "Hakim al-Ummah", the sage of the Ummah.
Abu al-Darda' ﵁ served as judge of this city under our master 'Umar ﵁.
The first of the Muhajirun to pass away in Madinah, buried in al-Baqi'.
Khalid ibn al-Walid ﵁ passed away in this city of al-Sham.
The city 'Amr ibn al-'As ﵁ founded beside the Nile, where his mosque still stands.
The district of Istanbul named after the Companion buried by its walls.
The brother of our master 'Umar ﵁, martyred at the Battle of Yamamah.
Bilal ﵁ moved to this land after our Beloved Prophet ﷺ passed away, and rests there by the common view.
The covenant our master 'Umar ﵁ gave the people of Jerusalem is known by this name.
The Companion blacksmith who was made to lie on burning coals in Makkah.
The Companion who kept a written collection of hadith called "al-Sahifah al-Sadiqah".
The woman Companion who taught our lady Hafsah ﵂ to write.
The woman Companion who set up a tent in the mosque to nurse the wounded.
The woman Companion married in turn to our masters Ja'far, Abu Bakr and 'Ali ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩.
The young Companion who reported what a hypocrite said and was confirmed by Surah al-Munafiqun.
The wife of Abu Sufyan ﵁ who accepted Islam when Makkah was opened.
The commander on the Iraq front before Khalid ﵁ came, from the tribe of Shayban.
The brother of Anas ibn Malik ﵁ who had himself thrown over the wall of Musaylimah's garden at Yamamah.
The uncle of Anas ibn Malik ﵁ who said he could smell the scent of Paradise beyond Uhud.
The Companion called "the Yusuf of this Ummah" for his handsome face, who destroyed the idol-house Dhu al-Khalasah.
The given name of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri ﵁.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said the wife "with the longest hand" would be first to join Him ﷺ; it was this lady, known for her giving.
The mother of our master 'Ali ﵁, who cared for our Beloved Prophet ﷺ in her home when He ﷺ was young.
Besides being His ﷺ uncle, our master Hamzah ﵁ was also our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ brother in this way.
The Mother of the Believers called "Umm al-Masakin" for her charity.
The Companion whose eye fell onto his cheek at Uhud and was put back by our Beloved Prophet ﷺ, becoming his better eye.
The Companion who carried our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ letter to Chosroes of Persia.
The Companion who carried our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ letter to al-Muqawqis of Egypt.
The Companion who carried our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ letter to the Negus.
The given name of Abu Talhah al-Ansari ﵁.
Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ announced in Madinah, with tears, the martyrdom of these three on the day they fell at Mu'tah.
items.a: Zayd, our master Ja'far and 'Abdullah ibn Rawahah ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩

items.q: The Companion with whom Zayd ibn Thabit ﵁ found the last verses of Surah al-Tawbah in writing.
The Ansari Companion who travelled for a month to hear a single hadith (meaning).
The four 'Abdullahs (al-'Abadilah).
items.a: Ibn 'Umar, Ibn 'Abbas, Ibn al-Zubayr, Ibn 'Amr ibn al-'As ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩

items.q: The Companion who told a friend, "Sit with us so we can believe for an hour" (meaning).
The Companion who said "I wish I were a tree that is cut down" (meaning) out of fear of Allah.
items.src: Sunan al-Tirmidhi (Abu Dharr's words at the end of the hadith)

items.q: The Companion who led the first Muslim navy, under our master 'Uthman ﵁.
The Battle of Dhat al-Sawari, around 31 to 34 AH (652 to 655 CE), was this kind of battle.
The woman Companion who sailed in the first naval expedition, as our Beloved Master ﷺ foretold.
The Companion who conquered Persia's capital al-Mada'in.
The Companion who founded Basrah as a garrison town.
The Companion governor of Kufah who founded it as a garrison town.
The Ansari Companion who was the "chief of the Khazraj" (meaning).
The book by Ibn 'Abd al-Barr ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ on the Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩.
The book by Ibn al-Athir ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ on the Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩.
The great book on the Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩ by Ibn Hajar al-'Asqalani ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩.
By Ibn Hajar's ⁨رحمة الله عليه⁩ definition, a Companion met our Beloved Prophet ﷺ believing in Him ﷺ and passed away in this state.
The nickname of our master Abu Bakr ﵁, meaning "the freed one" (from the Fire).
The kunyah of our master 'Umar ibn al-Khattab ﵁.
The last Companion to pass away in Basrah, our Beloved Prophet's ﷺ servant.
The last Companion to pass away in Kufah.
'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا)⁩ passed away in this town near Makkah al-Mukarramah.
Our lady Fatimah ﵂ passed away about this long after our Beloved Prophet ﷺ.
The Companion struck by an arrow at the Trench who asked Allah to let him live to see Banu Qurayzah judged.
The son of our master Abu Bakr ﵁ who carried news to the cave of Thawr each night.
The freed slave of our master Abu Bakr ﵁ who grazed sheep near the cave of Thawr to bring milk and hide the tracks.
The woman Companion with whom our Beloved Prophet ﷺ and our master Abu Bakr ﵁ stopped on the Hijrah, at whose tent a dry sheep gave milk.
The Companion whom our Beloved Prophet ﷺ sent ahead to teach the people of Yemen with Mu'adh ﵁.
The Ansari Companion in whose house the first Friday prayer in Madinah was held before the Hijrah, by one report.
The Companion who led the Muslims at Nahawand in 21 AH / 642 CE and was martyred there.
The Battle of Nahawand is known by this title, "the victory of victories".
The young Ansari martyr of Badr whom our Beloved Prophet ﷺ said was in al-Firdaws.
The father of Jabir ﵁, martyred at Uhud, to whom Allah spoke without a veil (meaning).
The Companion whom the angels ﵈ greeted with salam while he bore a long illness with patience.
The Ansari Companion who walked home with Usayd ibn Hudayr ﵁ on a dark night while a light shone from their sticks.
The woman Companion known as "the orator of the women", who asked our Beloved Prophet ﷺ about women's reward.
The Companion who is reported to have been born inside the Ka'bah.
The Companion who led the raid to Nakhlah in 2 AH, before Badr.
The Companion who governed Bahrain for our Beloved Prophet ﷺ and later for our master Abu Bakr ﵁.
The number of Companions ⁨(رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ)⁩ whose lives are in al-Isabah, roughly.
items.src: al-Isabah (Ibn Hajar); count to be checked

items.q: The cousin of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ, son of our master al-'Abbas ﵁, whose grave is honoured in Samarqand.
items.src: al-Isabah (Ibn Hajar); place of passing to be checked

items.q: He bought the well of Rumah for the Muslims | He was called Dhu al-Nurayn | He was the third rightly guided caliph
items.src: Sunan al-Tirmidhi, Kitab al-Manaqib; Sahih al-Bukhari, Fada'il al-Sahabah

items.q: Our Beloved Prophet ﷺ heard his footsteps ahead of him in Paradise | Under torture he kept saying "Ahad, Ahad" | He was the first mu'adhdhin of Islam
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari, Kitab al-Tahajjud; Sirat Ibn Hisham

items.q: At Mu'tah nine swords broke in his hand | He fought against the Muslims at Uhud before Islam | He was called Sayf Allah, the Sword of Allah
He passed away in the plague of 'Amwas | He is one of the ten promised Paradise | He was called the Trustworthy One of this Ummah
He travelled from Persia through Syria searching for the truth | He was freed by a contract the Muslims helped him pay | He advised digging the trench at al-Khandaq
items.src: Musnad Ahmad, hadith of Salman; al-Tabaqat al-Kubra of Ibn Sa'd

items.q: He left a life of luxury in Makkah for Islam | He was the first teacher sent to Madinah | He carried the banner at Uhud and was martyred there
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari, Kitab al-Jana'iz; Sirat Ibn Hisham

items.q: He was the uncle and foster-brother of our Beloved Prophet ﷺ | He was called the Lion of Allah | He was martyred at Uhud and called the Master of the Martyrs
items.src: al-Mustadrak of al-Hakim, Kitab Ma'rifat al-Sahabah; Sahih al-Bukhari, Kitab al-Maghazi
